title: Cloud Users and Groups
scenario: You are configuring cloud identity objects in Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365. Complete the activities below to demonstrate correct user creation, group configuration, dynamic membership logic, and license assignment.

activities.prompt: Arrange the following steps in the correct order to create a cloud-only user in Microsoft Entra ID.
steps: Select New user → Create new user
Enter account properties and create the account
answer: Select New user → Create new user
Enter account properties and create the account

activities.prompt: Match each group membership type to the correct behavior.
right: Membership is populated by attribute-based rules
answers: Membership is populated by attribute-based rules

activities.prompt: Complete the dynamic membership rule used to place users in a department-based dynamic group.
activities.explanation: Department-based dynamic groups use a user attribute value such as Clinical Services or Finance.

activities.prompt: Select the tasks that are part of cloud group management for this lab.
options: Promote a server to domain controller

activities.prompt: Select the location used to assign Microsoft 365 licenses to a cloud user.
options: Microsoft 365 Admin Center → Users → Active users
Microsoft Entra Admin Center → Devices → All devices
activities.answer: Microsoft 365 Admin Center → Users → Active users

activities.prompt: Match each administrative goal to the portal most directly used in this activity.
